import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_spmatrix structure
class GSLSpMatrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("size1", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("size2", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("nzmax", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("nz", ctypes.c_size_t),
        ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)),
        ("i", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)),
        ("p", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)),
        ("sptype", ctypes.c_int)
    ]

# Define the gsl_spmatrix_memcpy function prototype
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_memcpy.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLSpMatrix), ctypes.POINTER(GSLSpMatrix)]
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_memcpy.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Define the gsl_spmatrix_alloc and gsl_spmatrix_free function prototypes
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(GSLSpMatrix)

gsl.gsl_spmatrix_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLSpMatrix)]
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_free.restype = None

# Define the gsl_spmatrix_set function prototype
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLSpMatrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_set.restype = ctypes.c_int

# Define the gsl_spmatrix_get function prototype
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLSpMatrix), ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
gsl.gsl_spmatrix_get.restype = ctypes.c_double

def assert_test():
    # Allocate source and destination matrices
    rows, cols = 3, 3
    source = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc(rows, cols)
    destination = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc(rows, cols)

    try:
        # Populate the source matrix with some data
        data = np.array([[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 2.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.0, 3.0]], dtype=np.float64)
        for i in range(rows):
            for j in range(cols):
                if data[i, j] != 0.0:
                    ret_code = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_set(source, i, j, data[i, j])
                    assert ret_code == 0, f"gsl_spmatrix_set failed at ({i}, {j})"

        # Copy data from source to destination
        ret_code = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_memcpy(destination, source)
        assert ret_code == 0, "gsl_spmatrix_memcpy failed"

        # Verify that the destination matrix contains the same data
        for i in range(rows):
            for j in range(cols):
                src_value = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_get(source, i, j)
                dest_value = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_get(destination, i, j)
                assert dest_value == src_value, f"Data mismatch at ({i}, {j})"

        print("Test passed: Destination matrix matches source matrix.")

    finally:
        # Free the allocated matrices
        gsl.gsl_spmatrix_free(source)
        gsl.gsl_spmatrix_free(destination)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
